# 500 Informational Article Outlines: Whole-House Water Softener Systems

**Market:** United States  
**Intent:** Informational only  
**Publishing model:** 5 batches of 100 articles  
**Commercial content:** Deliberately excluded from this file  

## How to Use This Plan

- Publish in the numbered order unless Search Console data reveals a stronger opportunity.
- Keep each article inside its **intent boundary**. Do not merge adjacent questions merely because they share terminology.
- Answer the question immediately, then add diagnosis, evidence, steps, limitations, and the next action.
- Use original photos, water-test examples, diagrams, checklists, calculations, and field observations wherever possible.
- Do not make contaminant-reduction, health, code, or certification claims without checking a current primary source.
- Product rankings, brand reviews, model reviews, and “best” pages belong in the later commercial plan.

## SEO Constraints Applied

- Meta title: 60 characters maximum.
- Slug: 75 characters maximum.
- Meta description: 160 characters maximum.
- Every focus keyword, title, and slug is unique within this plan.

## Editorial Source Foundation

- EPA WaterSense - Cation Exchange Water Softeners: https://www.epa.gov/watersense/cation-exchange-water-softeners
